messages.body:
Hi Omar,

I heard through our project team that Atlas GA has moved again and that SAML SSO is still not available. To be direct: Globex cannot roll out Atlas to our 120 robots without SAML SSO through KeyGate. Our security policy does not allow shared or local credentials on fleet tooling. With our renewal coming up on 2026-11-30, this puts the $480k renewal at risk. I need a firm date for SSO availability, in writing, so I can take it to our steering committee.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Director of IT, Globex Logistics

Hi Dana,

Thank you for flagging this so clearly, and I understand the stakes. I'm looping in Devon Lee, who owns our SSO integration (ATL-212), and Sam Rivera, our Atlas product lead. Atlas GA is now planned for 2026-10-14. SSO is blocked on a signing-cert rotation bug in KeyGate's SAML metadata endpoint, and KeyGate's current fix ETA is Oct 9. Lena will follow up with a written SSO timeline you can share with your steering committee.

Best,
Omar Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Northwind Robotics

Hi Omar, Lena,

Following up: I still haven't received the written SSO timeline you mentioned on Sep 26. Our steering committee meets on Oct 15 and I need something concrete before then. If the date depends on KeyGate, please say so and tell me what the fallback is.

Thanks,
Dana Whitfield
Director of IT, Globex Logistics

subject: SAML metadata endpoint returning invalid signatures

messages.body:
Hi Victor,

We're seeing intermittent failures from the KeyGate SAML metadata endpoint for our Atlas tenant. Roughly 1 in 5 fetches returns metadata whose signature doesn't validate against the published signing cert, and it started right after your last cert rotation. This blocks our Enterprise SSO work (ATL-212) and our Atlas GA. Can you confirm whether this is on your side and share an ETA?

Thanks,
Devon Lee
Senior Engineer, Identity, Northwind Robotics

Hi Devon,

Confirmed: this is a bug in our signing-cert rotation. During rotation some metadata replicas keep serving documents signed with the retired key. Engineering has a fix in progress and the current ETA is Oct 9. Pinning the old cert won't work reliably, so I'd advise against a workaround on your side.

Best,
Victor Osei
Partner Solutions Engineer, KeyGate Identity

Hi Devon,

Apologies, the metadata fix has slipped. QA found a regression in multi-region failover, and the new ETA is Oct 13 at the earliest. I'll confirm as soon as the release is scheduled.

Best,
Victor Osei
Partner Solutions Engineer, KeyGate Identity

Hi Victor,

Thanks for the update. Our Atlas GA is set for Oct 14 and a major customer renewal depends on SSO, so "Oct 13 at the earliest" leaves us no margin. Could you share the contact for our executive sponsor at KeyGate so we can escalate? We'd also appreciate daily status until the fix ships.

Thanks,
Devon Lee
Senior Engineer, Identity, Northwind Robotics

subject: Billing v2 cutover: webhooks and proration

messages.body:
Hi Rina,

We're planning the Billing v2 cutover from our legacy billing service to PayStream usage-based billing. Two questions: can you guarantee at-least-once delivery with idempotency keys on invoice.finalized and payment.failed webhooks, and does PayStream prorate mid-cycle seat changes by day or by second? Our July proration bug came from mixing the two, so I want to get this right.

Thanks,
Mei Chen
Staff Engineer, Northwind Robotics

Hi Mei,

Yes, webhooks are at-least-once and every event carries an idempotency key, with retries for 72 hours. Proration is calculated by day in the subscription's billing timezone by default; per-second is available but we don't recommend it for invoiced accounts. I can set up a sandbox mirror of your production plans for cutover rehearsal.

Best,
Rina Kapoor
Account Manager, PayStream

Hi Rina,

Perfect, we'll use daily proration to match our contracts. Please set up the sandbox mirror; I'll run a dry-run cutover with a full month of replayed usage before we schedule production.

Thanks,
Mei Chen
Staff Engineer, Northwind Robotics

Hello,

Our July invoice from Northwind is about $4,900 higher than expected. We added 4 leased R2 units mid-June, but it looks like we were charged a full month for them on top of the June proration. Please review and send a corrected invoice.

Regards,
Accounts Payable
Stark Distribution

Hello,

Thanks for catching this. I've looped in Mei Chen, our billing service expert, who is investigating now. We'll confirm the root cause and the corrected amount shortly.

Best,
Omar Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Northwind Robotics

Hello,

We found the cause: a proration bug in our billing service double-counted mid-cycle unit additions (tracked internally as BIL-31). The fix is deployed and we've audited other accounts. We've issued a credit memo for $4,893.50, which will apply to your August invoice.

Best,
Mei Chen
Staff Engineer, Northwind Robotics

Hello Mei,

Credit memo received, thank you for the quick turnaround and the clear explanation.

Regards,
Accounts Payable
Stark Distribution

subject: R2 fleet dropping Wi-Fi since firmware 2.8

messages.body:
Omar,

Since firmware 2.8 our R2 Pickers drop off Wi-Fi when they roam between access points, several times per shift across both DCs. Every drop stalls picking for minutes and my floor leads are restarting units by hand. This is not acceptable for 80 robots during peak prep. I need a fix date.

Gavin Belson Jr.
VP Operations, Hooli Retail

Gavin,

I'm sorry for the disruption. This is a known regression in firmware 2.8 Wi-Fi roaming, and our CTO Raj Mehta is copied for the fix timeline. Marco Rossi from support will help your team with interim settings to reduce drops.

Best,
Omar Haddad
Customer Success Manager, Northwind Robotics

Gavin,

We've traced the drops to a change in the roaming scan logic in 2.8 (FW-77). The fix ships as hotfix firmware 2.8.1 (FW-80), which I own; we're validating it now and will offer Hooli early access before general rollout. Until then, Marco can lower the roaming threshold on your units, which cut drops by about half at other sites.

Raj Mehta
CTO, Northwind Robotics

Hi Priya,

We received 2 additional R2 units on Aug 20 for our Dayton site, but that expansion has been cancelled. We'd like to return both units for a refund. Please let me know if we're still within your refund window.

Thanks,
Nora Quinn
Operations Manager, Initech Warehousing

Hi Nora,

Yes, you're within our 30-day refund window (delivery Aug 20), so the refund for both units is approved. Marco Rossi will schedule the RMA pickup with ShipFast, and the refund is issued once the units pass inspection, usually within 5 business days.

Best,
Priya Shah
Support Lead, Northwind Robotics

Thanks Priya, that's great. Our dock is available any weekday morning for the pickup.

Nora Quinn
Operations Manager, Initech Warehousing

Hi,

We're considering adding 2 more R2 units. Your website policy page says refunds within 14 days, but a colleague told me it's longer now. Which is correct?

Thanks,
Theo Marsh
Facilities Lead, Soylent Grocers

Hi Theo,

Great question. Since our August policy review, the refund window is 30 days from delivery; the 14-day wording on the policy page is out of date and we're updating it. Units must be returned in working condition via our RMA process.

Best,
Priya Shah
Support Lead, Northwind Robotics

Hi Sam,

Two weeks into the Atlas beta across our 30 robots. The live fleet map and battery forecasting are excellent, and supervisors already prefer Atlas over the legacy console. Pain points: scheduling firmware updates per zone is clunky, and the alert feed gets noisy when robots reconnect after Wi-Fi drops. Happy to join a call.

Jill Ortega
Automation Manager, Umbrella Freight

Hi Jill,

This is really useful, thank you. Kai Nakamura (copied) is redesigning zone-based update scheduling, and we're adding alert deduplication for reconnect events. Could you do 30 minutes next Tuesday to walk Kai through your update workflow?

Best,
Sam Rivera
Senior Product Manager, Atlas

Tuesday at 10am Pacific works. I'll bring our shift supervisor too.

Jill Ortega
Automation Manager, Umbrella Freight
